title: journey-qa gate verdict
description: What a read-only judge returns for one phase. Every gate needs proof from evidence files or command output the judge ran itself; missing evidence is a fail.

proof.description: Command run and its exit code, or evidence file path.

fix.description: What the repair pass must change. Never 'edit the gate'.

images.description: One entry per image the judge opened. Required whenever the phase produced images.

described.description: What the image actually shows, in the judge's own words.

escalate.description: Things only the user can decide (waivers, meaning-changing edits, exemptions).
